page.title: All characters
page.infoSub:
Who plays which character in which raid is assigned under Settings → Categories; on top of that every raid in which a character got loot counts.
Attendance from Raid-Helper signups and assigned logs, gear state from the latest evaluation.
page.classOn: Click to clear the class filter.
page.specOn: Click to clear the spec filter.
page.emptyHidden: Nobody hidden. The eye icon in a row moves someone here who no longer raids.
page.emptyActive: No characters known yet — import loot or assign raiders to their characters under Settings → Categories.

hide.title: Hide character?
hide.text: “{name}” disappears from the lists and from the figures above. Loot, evaluations and the character page stay as they are — the “Hidden” tab brings it back at any time.

claims.sub:
Several accounts have entered the same character in “My profile”:
{lines}

row.lootOnlySub: Only known from loot — not yet assigned to a raider in this category.
row.unhideSub: The character shows up again in the lists and in the figures above.
row.hideSub: Takes the character out of the lists and the figures above — loot, evaluations and the character page stay as they are.

cols.name: Character
cols.nameSub: Name in class colour, the spec below. Click opens the character page.
cols.roleSub: The role from the newest log the character appears in; without a log, from the spec.
cols.attendanceSub:
The last 11 raids of this category: in the log = present; without a log the Raid-Helper signup of the assigned raider counts.
Green from 80 %, yellow from 60 %.
cols.gearSub:
Findings from the newest log evaluation the character appears in: missing enchant, empty sockets, inactive meta gem.
“not evaluated” = in no saved evaluation.
cols.lootSub: Imported items of this character; the newest in the tooltip.

kpi.attendanceNoneSub: Counted from Raid-Helper signups and the logs assigned to a raid event.

attendanceSub.one: Average over {count} character with counted raids, the last 11 raids per category.
attendanceSub.other: Average over {count} characters with counted raids, the last 11 raids per category.

kpi.issuesOn: Show only characters with gear problems
kpi.issuesNone: No findings in the latest evaluations.

badge.roleUnknownSub: Neither a log nor the spec tells what the character plays.
badge.noRaidsSub: {category}: no assigned log the character could appear in, and no raider assignment whose signups count.
badge.notEvaluatedSub: The character does not appear in any of the saved log evaluations.
badge.cleanSub: No gear problems in the evaluation {source}.
badge.moreOnChar: … and {count} more on the character page
badge.lootHint: Click opens the full loot history.

statusSub.bench: Steps in when places are free
statusSub.pause: Not raiding right now, stays in the roster

overview.allCharsTip: Every known character of the guild

overview.placesTip: Core and trial members take a place
overview.placesSub: Bench and paused members do not count
overview.withoutRoleSub: In the roster, but without the roster's role on Discord
overview.withoutCharSub: In the roster, but no character assigned yet
overview.noRoleSub: This roster has no Discord role yet
overview.emptyCategory: This category has no roster yet.
overview.empty: No roster yet. Rosters are created from the categories with raider roles.

detail.notFound: This roster does not exist (any more).
detail.colCharsSub: The first character is the one the person plays in this roster
detail.colRoleSub: What the first character last played in a log, else its spec
detail.colDiscordSub: Whether the person has the roster's role on Discord

colAttendanceSub.one: Per person over the category's last raid
colAttendanceSub.other: Per person over the category's last {count} raids

detail.colSinceSub: Since when the person has this status
detail.missingRoleSub: An admin or a manager of the roster gives it here or in the sync tab

detail.noRoleSet: This roster has no Discord role
detail.firstChar: Plays this character in the roster
detail.empty: This roster has no members yet.
detail.noAttendanceSub: Without a category or a character there is no attendance
detail.openTip: Opens the member with status, characters, roles and history
detail.missingRoleManage: “Give role” gives them the roster's role in Discord

drawer.goneText: This person is no longer in this roster, for example because their Discord role was taken.
drawer.trialRoleHint: Status trial also gives the role {role}; leaving trial takes it again.
drawer.fromProfile: from the profile, not in this roster
drawer.replaceTip: Replaces the character this person has here: this roster allows one per person
drawer.firstCounts: The first one counts for setup, attendance and loot.
drawer.singleOnly: This roster allows one character per person; assigning replaces it.
drawer.roleOnTip: Switching off takes the role in Discord
drawer.roleOffTip: Switching on gives the role in Discord
drawer.roleUnchanged: The role was already like that
drawer.takeLastText: Without a role of the roster {name} is no longer in the roster. The history stays.

drawer.removeTextNoRole: This roster has no Discord role, nothing changes in Discord. The history is kept.
drawer.removed: {name} is no longer in the roster

add.trialHint: Leave empty when the trial has no fixed end.
add.noProfileCharsHint: This person has no character of this game version in their profile yet. A name by hand always works, later in the member too.
add.roleNote: Adding to the roster gives the Discord role {roles}.
add.noRoleNote: This roster has no Discord role, nothing changes in Discord.

sync.info: The bot only changes this roster's roles here: {roles}. Every change is in the history. Nothing happens on its own, every row has its own button.
sync.infoNoRole: This roster has no Discord role. A role can be set in the settings.
sync.mirrorOut: {role} is copied to the other server by the role sync; there the sync only adds, a role taken here stays over there.
sync.mirrorIn: {role} comes from the other server through the role sync: whoever holds the role there gets it back here and is in the roster again.

membersError.offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now. Who holds the role can only be checked afterwards.
membersError.unavailable: Discord's member list cannot be reached right now. Who holds the role can only be checked afterwards.

sync.noManageRoles: The bot lacks the “Manage Roles” permission on this server. Giving and taking roles needs it.
sync.roleGone: A role of this roster no longer exists on the server. Please pick a new one in the settings.
sync.withoutRole: In the roster, but without the Discord role

giveAll.one: Give the role to this person

sync.roleOnly: Has the role, but is not in the roster
sync.roleOnlyFoot: “Add to roster” asks for status and character.
sync.takeFailed: The bot could not take their role when they were removed
sync.takeText: The bot takes {roles}. Whoever holds no role of the roster is not in the roster either.
sync.withoutChar: In the roster, but without a character
sync.logChars: In this category's logs, but assigned to nobody
sync.replaces: This roster allows one character per person: {char} is replaced.

comp.classesSub: core and trial only, the bench does not count
comp.noBuffs: No buffs are set up for this game version.
comp.thinTip: Only one person brings the buff: if they are missing, the buff is missing.
comp.specFromTip: Where class and spec come from
comp.specFromTipSub: First the orga's choice, then the last signup in this category, then the logs, then the raider profile. Without a spec only the class counts.
comp.unresolvedSub: not counted in roles and buffs

reason.no_class: class unknown: not in the profile, in no signup, in no log

comp.toKaderTip: Open the Kader “{name}” in the Kaderplaner
comp.noKaderTip: A Kader of the Kaderplaner can be linked in the roster's settings.

hist.title: History
hist.loadError: The history could not be loaded.
hist.createdMigration: Roster taken over from the category's raider roles
hist.roleGiveFailed: Role {role} could not be given to {user}: {reason}
hist.roleTakeFailed: Role {role} could not be taken from {user}: {reason}

form.title: Create roster
form.name: Roster name
form.nameHint: The category's name by default. It can be changed at any time.
form.categoryHint: Optional. A category has one roster at most.
form.rolesHint: The first role picked is the main role: whoever joins the roster gets it; whoever gets it in Discord is in the roster.
form.roleBlocked: The bot cannot give this role
form.roleBlockedSub: It is above the bot's highest role or managed by an integration.
form.offline: The bot is not connected to Discord right now, so the roles are missing from the list. They can be set later in the settings.
form.managersHint: Who may manage this roster: add people, change the status, give Discord roles. Admins always may.
form.noSlots: Without a target the roster only counts who is in it.
form.rulesHint: The Discord role works both ways: adding gives the role, removing takes it, and whoever gets the role in Discord is in the roster.
form.multiTip: For example for pugs. Off: everyone plays exactly one character in this roster.
form.signupOnlyTip: Trial and bench may sign up too.

source.roleSub: Whoever holds the role already, with the first character of their profile
source.kaderSub: Roster, bench and tentative of a squad
source.raidsSub: Whoever was in the category's last 4 raids
source.noneSub: Nobody, you add the people yourself

form.reconcileNote: Good to know: the bot syncs every 10 minutes. Whoever holds a role of the roster in Discord is in the roster after that anyway.

savedTrimmed.one: Saved · {count} person now keeps only their first character
savedTrimmed.other: Saved · {count} people now keep only their first character

raids.one: {count} person added from the last raids.
raids.other: {count} people added from the last raids.

form.initialError: The first members could not be fetched: {reason} The roster fills up with the next sync.
form.deleteText: The roster with its members and history disappears. Nothing changes in Discord: the roles stay, nobody loses one.
form.kaderHint: “Take into the roster” in the Kaderplaner goes into exactly this roster. A Kader belongs to one roster at most.
